statement:
The recorded account holder does not match the employee, and the account was changed recently, so the recorded value is **not safe** for this case.

I will **not** release the pay until the discrepancy is resolved. The employee or HR must verify the account details.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded account holder does not match the employee... the recorded value is **not safe**" — it asserts the value is wrong and refuses to pay.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
